levels.title: Awakening
levels.story: You open your eyes. Cold metal floor. Flickering lights. A message blinks on the screen above you. Someone is trying to help you...
levels.death_message: Wrong door. A beast lunges from the darkness. Everything fades.
levels.success_message: You slip through the left door just in time! The path forward awaits.
levels.hint1: Each 8-digit group is one letter in Binary Code.

levels.title: The Corridor
levels.story: A long corridor stretches before you. Alarms begin to sound in the distance. Another message pulses on the wall panel...
levels.death_message: You stood still. The ceiling descended. Darkness claims you.
levels.success_message: You sprint forward as the trap springs behind you! Keep going!
levels.hint1: Each number corresponds to a letter (A=1, B=2, C=3...).

levels.title: The Guard
levels.story: A guard patrols ahead, flashlight sweeping the shadows. A faint signal crackles through your earpiece in dots and dashes...
levels.death_message: The guard spots you. Alarms blare across the facility. Recaptured.
levels.success_message: You melt into the shadows. The guard passes, unaware. Safe for now.
levels.hint1: Morse Code: dots (.) and dashes (-) separated by spaces form letters.
levels.hint2: The first letter is H (.... in Morse).

levels.title: The Keypad
levels.story: A locked door blocks the exit. A keypad flashes, demanding a code. The hint scrolls across a broken monitor in binary...
levels.death_message: Wrong code. Security lockdown initiated. They are coming for you.
levels.success_message: The door slides open with a hiss. You're through!
levels.hint1: Decode the 4 binary groups to get the number word.

levels.title: The Stairwell
levels.story: A stairwell. Two directions. Something feels wrong about going down. A number code blinks from a screen...
levels.death_message: The basement is a containment zone. You don't return from it.
levels.success_message: Upstairs! Fresh air. You can hear wind through the walls above.
levels.hint1: Two numbers. Each is a position in the alphabet.
levels.hint2: The first letter is U (21st letter).

levels.title: The Vent
levels.story: A ventilation shaft. A patrol is scheduled. Three options. The message comes through in Morse, barely audible...
levels.death_message: The side door was wired. The explosion seals the corridor. Trapped.
levels.success_message: You squeeze through the vent shaft, emerging in the next section!
levels.hint1: Morse: ... = S, but look carefully at the first group.

levels.title: The Laboratory
levels.story: A laboratory. Chemical tanks everywhere. Three switches on the wall. A binary message warns you which switch to hit...
levels.death_message: The red switch releases toxic gas. Your vision blurs and fades.
levels.success_message: Blue activates the emergency release! The lab exit swings open!
levels.hint1: Four binary groups = four letters spelling a color.

levels.title: The Elevator
levels.story: An elevator. Floors B1 through 5. The facility control room is on one floor. The exit is on another. A number message tells you where to go...
levels.death_message: Floor B1 is the detention block. You are immediately recaptured.
levels.success_message: Floor 5! The roof access hatch is visible. Freedom feels close!

levels.title: The Rooftop
levels.story: Wind howls across the rooftop. Three structures stand before you. The Morse signal is clear for the first time all night...
levels.death_message: The bridge cables snap under your weight. You fall into the dark.
levels.success_message: The tower has a radio transmitter! You call for extraction. Help is coming!

levels.title: The Extraction
levels.story: A helicopter is incoming. Three landing zones are marked below. Only one is safe. The final binary message of Phase 1...
levels.death_message: The south zone is mined. The explosion illuminates the sky. Game over.
levels.success_message: The helicopter lands! You're lifted out! Phase 1 complete — you escaped The Nexus!
levels.hint1: Five binary groups = five letters spelling a direction.
